guard/30922.htm.text: Guard Cage: Greetings! Isn't it a beautiful day? This road goes by Alligator Island . I'm an expert on the island if you are interested in going there.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30922-1.htm.text: Guard Cage: As the name suggests, the island is swarming with alligators! It is a popular tourist destination, where travelers go to sample the delicious meet or collect the valuable pelts of these reptiles.
